Data:Nxc.n.apollo.agdistis.help.the.sopr.label: Help the soprano ascend via a Heart path
Data:Nxc.n.apollo.agdistis.help.the.sopr.preface: 'The soprano - her name is Elodie - she has expressed certain longings to me, of higher modes of being. She has the Cross-nature in her - but I do not think she should pursue it. Sometimes the Cross frightens me, my friend. I fear what it would replace. So I had hoped to tutor her in the New Form, as I did back in the Ecdysis days, but she will have nothing to do with the Ligeians. Still I think there may be a way. Do you have anything detailed on duendrazones? Or just something good on Tridesma Hiera [10]?'
Data:Nxc.n.apollo.agdistis.help.the.sopr.desc: 'I am sorry; that is not what I had hoped for. Is there something else?'

Data:Nxc.n.apollo.corso.help.the.soprano.label: Help the soprano ascend via a Sky path
Data:Nxc.n.apollo.corso.help.the.soprano.preface: 'So the soprano - Elodie - lovely woman - we got talking. I say we got talking. Pretty sure she managed the whole thing, got herself an introduction. And she's asked me very nicely to help her express her, you might say, inner self. I'd like to help. But I don't know as much as I'd like to. How about Coseley on the Carapace? Or anything good on Resurgences & Emergences [10]?'
Data:Nxc.n.apollo.corso.help.the.soprano.desc: 'Nah, can't get anything out of that. Take another look in the back?'

Data:Nxc.n.apollo.morgen.help.the.sopran.label: Help the soprano ascend via a Heart path

I have a woman at the opera in mind; a woman with potential. Never mind why. Call it another ulterior motive. Help me, please. I am hoping you have something comprehensive on duendrazones, perhaps. Or matters of Tridesma Hiera [10].'
Data:Nxc.n.apollo.morgen.help.the.sopran.desc: 'That's not what I meant at all. Do you have anything else?'

Data:Nxc.n.casket.cracked.coquille.help..label: Help Coquille
Data:Nxc.n.casket.cracked.coquille.help..preface: 'The prisoner can be seen in the world now, in mirrors and paintings, but the seals still partly hold. Even photographs of flames… need to block him out there, then we can work on the Casket. Have you got anything decent on Sights & Sensations [10+]? Or Husher might have some ideas, if you've got anything by Husher.'

Data:Nxc.n.debt.arun.democratise.the.wan.label: Democratise the 'Wangle'
Data:Nxc.n.debt.arun.democratise.the.wan.preface: 'The London Reckoners call it 'the Wangle', did you know that? One of the Reckoner lords in Kaunas has found a way to win years of life out of the Madrugad's tally. If I can determine how that's done… I'd like to share the secret more widely. It'll cause a great deal of trouble. I'm looking forward to it. But I need your help. Do you have anything on Disciplines of the Scar [10]? Or... anything on the Winter Tower here at Brancrug?'
Data:Nxc.n.debt.arun.democratise.the.wan.desc: 'Another knot of mysteries unresolved. If you ever think you've found an end to tug on, tell me.'

Data:Nxc.n.debt.azita.profit.from.the.wa.label: Profit from the 'Wangle'
Data:Nxc.n.debt.azita.profit.from.the.wa.preface: 'I knocked some heads and learnt some truths: a way to pervert the Madrugad's tally and win extra years of life. Farther West, they're calling it 'the Wangle', now, because English is not a dignified language... no matter. A very profitable trick, if one can learn to work it. It's a matter of scars, I think, and a business of bones. Do you have anything on Disciplines of the Scar [10]? Or on - bear with me - the Madrugad's presence in the bones of the living and the dead?'

Data:Nxc.n.debt.connie.shut.down.the.wan.label: Shut down the 'Wangle'
Data:Nxc.n.debt.connie.shut.down.the.wan.preface: 'A way to cheat extra years out of the Madrugad… of course it's already spreading beyond Kaunas. Over here, they call it 'the Wangle'. Idiots. I need to make this stop, and I need to make it stop soon, before the Hours resolve the matter their way. I think that means drawing the Madrugad's personal attention. I really don't know how to do that safely. Or at all, really. Do you have anything on the Ragged Crossroads [10]? Or there's a Church rite they used to call the White Ceremony, if you have any record of the original version...'
Data:Nxc.n.debt.connie.shut.down.the.wan.desc: 'Nothing that could help? Thank you for looking. Let me know if you do find anything.'
